turningtorso.name: Turning Torso
turningtorso.slogan: A tower that wrings itself out above the Öresund.
turningtorso.line: Completed in 2005 and designed by Santiago Calatrava, its top is twisted 90 degrees relative to its base.

lunddomclock.name: Lund Cathedral Clock
lunddomclock.slogan: Knights clash, the Three Kings parade, and Lund checks its watch.
lunddomclock.line: Its crypt was consecrated in 1123, and the astronomical clock above has plodded on since around 1425.

alesstenar.name: Ale's Stones
alesstenar.slogan: A stone ship moored on a Baltic cliff, sails long gone.
alesstenar.line: 59 boulders of up to 5 tonnes form a ship outline 67 metres long, probably raised around 550 CE.

malmohus.name: Malmöhus Castle
malmohus.slogan: Moat, brick towers and a Scottish earl locked inside.
malmohus.line: The Earl of Bothwell, third husband of Mary Queen of Scots, was imprisoned here from 1567 to 1573.

karnan.name: Kärnan
karnan.slogan: Helsingborg's brick keep, staring Denmark down across the strait.
karnan.line: Tree-ring dating shows the core of this fortress tower was built in the 1310s.
